questions.q: What should you do first when the Operations Manager reports a mismatch, before touching any measure?
options: Immediately delete the Total Sales (All Regions) measure
Assume the Operations Manager made an error and close the ticket
Rebuild the entire data model from scratch
Reproduce the problem reliably yourself, with the exact filter the report described
questions.explain: Reproducing the issue under known conditions turns a vague complaint into two concrete, comparable numbers.

questions.q: Why do you test more than one region (Pacific, then Europe, then a third) instead of stopping after the first mismatch?
options: It has no diagnostic value; one region is always enough
Isolating the variable by changing one thing at a time reveals the real pattern, not just a single data point
Testing multiple regions is required by Power BI licensing
To make the Executive Summary page refresh faster
questions.explain: Changing the region while holding everything else constant is what reveals whether the Executive Summary card responds to the filter at all.

questions.q: What is the actual diagnostic 'tell' discovered in this lesson?
options: Both numbers are always off by exactly $100
The numbers match for Pacific but not for any other region
The Executive Summary's headline Total Sales never changes, no matter which region is selected
The Drill-Down page crashes when a region is selected
questions.explain: A figure that stays identical regardless of the one filter meant to control it strongly suggests it isn't using that filter at all.

questions.q: What measure from Lesson 6 becomes a lead worth following, given that tell?
options: Prior Week Sales, which shifts the date filter
Order Count, which counts distinct orders
Total Sales (All Regions), which was built specifically to ignore the region filter
Avg Days to Ship, which has nothing to do with regions
questions.explain: A measure built on purpose to strip the region filter via ALL(TerritoryDim) is exactly the kind of thing that would behave this way if bound to the wrong card.

questions.q: What does this lesson explicitly say NOT to do yet?
options: Record the numbers for each region tested
Open both report pages to compare them
Rewrite any measure, delete Total Sales (All Regions), or guess which card is 'probably' wrong
Change the Region slicer at all
questions.explain: The lesson is about reproducing and isolating the symptom; confirming the actual cause is Lesson 11's job before anything changes.
